# shopify_metafield_definition (List Resource)

Lists the metafield definitions of one owner type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "shopify_metafield_definition" "product" {
  provider = shopify

  config {
    owner_type = "PRODUCT"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner_type` (String) Owner resource type, e.g. `PRODUCT`. Without the app's read scope for that type the list can come back empty.
